text:
vijay: Heads-up: Reseller partner OrbitEdge submitted a mid-cycle adjustment request for May — they claim seats were misapplied to a legacy plan and only 45 seats should've billed, not 450. Invoice INV-2026-0517 shows $90,000.
emma: that's a huge gap. do we have the subscription mapping?
audrey: digging. looks like an import script used plan_id mapping table that still had the old sku mapping for plan_legacy -> redwood-seat-legacy, multiply applied by factor 10 during normalization. grabbing raw rows.
billing-bot: upload complete: reseller_adjusts_may_2026.csv -> /finance/partner-uploads/OrbitEdge/INV-2026-0517.csv
recon-bot: automated-recon: diff between partner submitted reconciliation and our invoice shows delta: $81,000 attributable to plan mapping multiplier error.
vijay: what's the remediation path? partner requests invoice reversal + corrected invoice. OrbitEdge prefers credit applied but will accept refund if needed.
emma: controller signoff required if credit > $10k. @cfo-june can you confirm approval path?
cfo-june: approve corrective invoicing; require one-line root cause and remediation steps. Also need GL reversal code REV-RSLR-3 and attach corrected booking entries.
vijay: will prepare corrected invoice and a remediation checklist: (1) fix plan_id mapping in import table, (2) run backfill to re-map historical rows for May, (3) add validation that qty multiplier <= 2x expected change to catch gross multiplies.
audrey: also adding a pre-flight check in the ETL job to surface plan_id mismatches to a manual queue.
emma: drafting NetSuite reversal RN-2026-0517 and new invoice INV-2026-0517-REV with corrected amt $9,000. routing to @cfo-june.
cfo-june: signed. please include the corrected ledger and attach the reconciliation note.
vijay: processed. OrbitEdge notified and accepted credit to next cycle. Finance ops to record GL entries and note for audit.
recon-bot: closing ticket RECON-3072, marking incident for postmortem review.
emma: will include this in monthly partner reconciliation call agenda. closing thread. :+1:
